detail: Full summary: legacy-scan reports layout v2 for ANY file under records/, so a migrate rerun on a v1 store sees records/RECORDS-FROZEN.md (written by finalize) and reads the store as v1+v2 — migrated_from flipped 1 -> 2 on every rerun and legacy/manifest.json's layouts is likewise unstable across reruns. finalize now preserves the first run's migrated_from from the existing store.json; the manifest instability is untouched (root-cause fix belongs in legacy-scan: exclude RECORDS-FROZEN.md, or a non-.json file, from the v2 heuristic).
